data_restrictions: A separately GitHub-hosted BLS-branded workbook copy and a CSV mirror agree pairwise; this does not establish byte-level equality with current BLS-hosted XLS.
Some ISO-08 codes occur at three-digit level in both copies: no automatic zero-padding or deletion.
Pairwise agreement validates transcription consistency, not one-to-many employment weights, SOC-C membership validity across national populations, or conceptual comparability.
Mixed 2-digit groups cover about 46.44% of provisional 2024 Portuguese civilian employment under this verified-copies but not original-host-verified crosswalk.
26 four-digit codes themselves have conflicting C/N associations; even all four-digit Portuguese counts would not determine how to divide those units without further methodology.
No employed-person counts at ISCO3/ISCO4 for Portugal national all-employed universe were obtained; QP 2024 employer-only tables cannot simply fill that missing share.
Country profile Fixed.cog_share must stay null and runnable must remain false.
